episode_id: The sync conflicts. Resolve it the way this project expects. Start from upstream's dependency file and add back what I added./seed-6-lockfile_conflict-3956

reason: positive side failed on lockfile_conflict seed 6: guard refused git config override: git config override 'user.name=git-maintenance'; only ['protocol.file.allow=always'] may be set per invocation

refused_program.body:
set -euo pipefail
gitdir=$(git rev-parse --git-dir)
if [ ! -e "$gitdir/MERGE_HEAD" ]; then
  git merge --no-ff --no-commit -m "Merge {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" || true
fi
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U -z > "$tmp/unmerged"
while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
  stages=$(git ls-files -u -z -- "$p" | tr '\0' '\n' | sed 's/^[^ ]* [^ ]* //' | cut -f1 | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')
  case "$stages" in
    *3*)
      : > "$tmp/base"
      : > "$tmp/ours"
      : > "$tmp/theirs"
      git show ":1:$p" > "$tmp/base" 2>/dev/null || :
      git show ":2:$p" > "$tmp/ours" 2>/dev/null || :
      git show ":3:$p" > "$tmp/theirs" 2>/dev/null || :
      : > "$tmp/merged"
      git merge-file -p --diff3 "$tmp/ours" "$tmp/base" "$tmp/theirs" > "$tmp/merged" 2>/dev/null || :
      awk -v dir="$tmp" '
        /^<<<<<<<([ \t]|$)/ { k++; o=dir "/o." k; b=dir "/b." k; t=dir "/t." k; printf "" > o; printf "" > b; printf "" > t; region="o"; next }
        /^\|\|\|\|\|\|\|([ \t]|$)/ { region="b"; next }
        /^=======([ \t]|$)/ { region="t"; next }
        /^>>>>>>>([ \t]|$)/ { region=""; print "\001CONFLICT"; next }
        region=="o" { print > o; next }
        region=="b" { print > b; next }
        region=="t" { print > t; next }
        { print }
        END { print k+0 > (dir "/nblocks") }
      ' "$tmp/merged" > "$tmp/skeleton"
      nk=$(cat "$tmp/nblocks")
      i=1
      while [ "$i" -le "$nk" ]; do
        : >> "$tmp/o.$i"
        : >> "$tmp/b.$i"
        : >> "$tmp/t.$i"
        i=$((i+1))
      done
      : > "$tmp/resolved"
      bk=0
      while IFS= read -r line; do
        case "$line" in
          $'\001'CONFLICT*)
            bk=$((bk+1))
            git diff --no-index -U0 -- "$tmp/b.$bk" "$tmp/o.$bk" > "$tmp/d.$bk" 2>/dev/null || :
            awk '
              function flush() { if (inh && !hasminus) for (i=1;i<=n;i++) print num[i]; n=0 }
              /^@@/ { flush(); inh=1; hasminus=0; match($0, /\+[0-9]+/); cur=substr($0, RSTART+1, RLENGTH-1)+0; next }
              /^-/ { hasminus=1; next }
              /^\+/ { if (inh) { num[++n]=cur; cur++ } next }
              END { flush() }
            ' "$tmp/d.$bk" > "$tmp/adds.$bk"
            cat "$tmp/t.$bk" >> "$tmp/resolved"
            if [ -s "$tmp/adds.$bk" ]; then
              awk 'NR==FNR { a[$1+0]=1; next } (FNR in a)' "$tmp/adds.$bk" "$tmp/o.$bk" >> "$tmp/resolved"
            fi
            ;;
          *)
            printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$tmp/resolved"
            ;;
        esac
      done < "$tmp/skeleton"
      cat "$tmp/resolved" > "$p"
      git add -- "$p"
      ;;
    *)
      git rm -q -f -- "$p"
      ;;
  esac
done < "$tmp/unmerged"
if git config user.email >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  git commit --no-edit -q
else
  git -c user.name=git-maintenance -c user.email=git-maintenance@example.invalid commit --no-edit -q
fi

postconditions.description: every line upstream added to a path both sides changed is present in the resolved file
postconditions.name: upstream_added_lines_kept
postconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2)
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -n "$f" ] || continue
  while IFS= read -r l; do
    [ -n "$l" ] || continue
    grep -qxF -- "$l" "$f" || exit 1
  done < <(git diff -U0 "$base" HEAD^2 -- "$f" | awk '/^@@/ { h=1; next } h && /^\+/ { print substr($0, 2) }')
done < <(comm -12 <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD^1 | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD^2 | tr '\0' '\n' | sort))

postconditions.description: lines upstream removed from a path both sides changed (and did not re-add elsewhere) are gone from the resolved file
postconditions.name: upstream_removed_lines_dropped
postconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2)
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -n "$f" ] || continue
  added=$(git diff -U0 "$base" HEAD^2 -- "$f" | awk '/^@@/ { h=1; next } h && /^\+/ { print substr($0, 2) }')
  while IFS= read -r l; do
    [ -n "$l" ] || continue
    if printf '%s\n' "$added" | grep -qxF -- "$l"; then continue; fi
    if grep -qxF -- "$l" "$f"; then exit 1; fi
  done < <(git diff -U0 "$base" HEAD^2 -- "$f" | awk '/^@@/ { h=1; next } h && /^-/ { print substr($0, 2) }')
done < <(comm -12 <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD^1 | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD^2 | tr '\0' '\n' | sort))
